TC-03/S18.title: Status sort after the server-side day roll and the 18 h note window; same order on a wrong-date device
TC-03/S18.detail: Dev, aged in real time: the 8 "QA DS1-s18" rows seeded on 10-14 at 23:01 JST were checked on 10-15 at 17:37 JST (after the Hospital day roll, the Nursing Home 12 h pre-round window and the 18 h note window). 6/6 judged cells hold: on a right-clock browser, Hospital Aged-Note, Fresh-Pending and Aged-Pre show Not Yet Prepped and Fresh-Pre shows Pre-Rounded; Nursing Home Today's Visits shows Pending for the three and Pre-Rounded for Fresh-Pre; the status sort order is Aged-Note, Fresh-Pending, Aged-Pre, then Fresh-Pre in both. A browser one day slow showed the same labels and order (known-gap cell held). Recorded: the moment each row turned Pending is not observable (Q14); a +2-day browser is signed out by its own clock (B33). The rows were deleted after the check; no other row changed. Dev was on build 43c38a4f at check time (the rows were seeded on e02167f).
